description: Source code for BluetoothServer class that manages Bluetooth socket connections and forwards HTTP-like requests over Bluetooth, acting as a layer on top of a local HTTP server.

classes.name: BluetoothServer
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth server socket, accepts client connections, and spawns ClientConnection threads to handle requests.

classes.name: ClientConnection
classes.description: Handles individual Bluetooth client connections, processes incoming requests, and serves files or directory listings.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all client connections and the server socket.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main server loop that listens for Bluetooth connections and spawns client handler threads.

methods.name: ClientConnection.run
methods.description: Handles communication with a connected Bluetooth client, processes requests, and sends responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, determines response status, and prepares response content.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Serves files or directories based on the request URI, handling security and directory listing.

methods.name: serveFile
methods.description: Serves a file with support for range requests and ETag caching.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a NanoHTTPD response with specified status, mime type, and content.

methods.name: getMimeTypeForFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type based on file extension.

methods.name: findIndexFileInDirectory
methods.description: Finds index.html or similar in a directory.
